input.description: The image shows a Toshiba microwave oven. The control panel on the right side of the microwave has various buttons and a digital display. The display currently shows "0:05". The buttons include options for Sensor Reheat, Frozen Pizza, Frozen Entree, Potato, Rice, Veggie, Custom Cook, Soften/Melt, Popcorn, Favorite, Clock, 1 lb Defrost, Custom Defrost, and Kitchen Timer. There is a numeric keypad with numbers from 1 to 9, and 0, along with Power Level, Cook Time, and a large "Start/+30Sec" button. Below the Start button is a red "Stop/Cancel" button. The microwave door is on the left side of the image, and there is a Toshiba logo on the bottom left corner of the door. The microwave is placed on a countertop with a wooden support visible underneath.
